title: Replication Package for "Process Mining and Stochastic Modeling for Software Process Forecasting: A Systematic Literature Review with an LLM-Assisted Protocol"
description: Full replication artefact for a systematic literature review at the intersection of process mining, stochastic modeling, and machine-learning forecasting applied to software-development processes. Includes: search strings for five databases (Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, Springer Link, Web of Science); deduplication, enrichment, and screening pipelines; LLM screening prompts and JSON schemas (claude-haiku-4-5 primary, claude-sonnet-4-6 verifier); 8-criterion quality-assessment rubric (Dyba and Dingsoyr, 2008); cross-model Cohen's kappa verification scripts and reports; decision CSVs at every pipeline stage; structured extraction tables; PRISMA flow snapshot; snowballing-v2 outputs; EC5 audit results; sensitivity analysis. Reproduces the figures and tables of the corresponding manuscript submitted to Information and Software Technology (Elsevier). PDFs of primary studies are not redistributed (copyright); DOIs are provided in results/final_review/included_studies_current.csv.
